channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Willie Cauley-Stein | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Willie Cauley-Stein from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dereck Lively on Hakeem Olajuwon, Anthony Davis, Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
When asked who he’d compare himself to at the NBA level, Lively gave a diverse list of players.

“I’d definitely say Willie Cauley-Stein,and you’ve got aspects of Anthony Davis’ game and Hakeem Olajuwon’s game,”

Dereck Lively on Hakeem Olajuwon, Anthony Davis, Willie Cauley-Stein, May 28, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Willie Cauley-Stein:

“He just has a good feel and understand -- a natural feel for the flow of the game. When he was on the floor for us last year our defensive numbers were very, very strong. We really like him and we're glad we got him back.”

Rick Carlisle on Willie Cauley-Stein, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Roger Montgomery on Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
“That being said, I’m hopeful they will not even give Willie his qualifying offer so Willie can be an unrestricted free agent.”

Roger Montgomery on Willie Cauley-Stein, Jun 23, 2019. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Roger Montgomery on Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
“We’ve kind of hoped that things would change over the years and Willie would get a chance to expand his game, get a chance to get some consistency there in terms of the roster turnover and the coaching turnover and the things that have not been steady there,”

Roger Montgomery on Willie Cauley-Stein, Jun 23, 2019. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: George Karl on Blake Griffin, Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
Jason Jones:George Karl:

“I don't think Willie should be indoctrinated into the NBA by covering Blake Griffin.”

George Karl on Blake Griffin, Willie Cauley-Stein, Oct 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: George Karl on Willie Cauley-Stein
item.description:
Bill Herenda:George Karl:

“Willie Cauley-Stein gives a defensive dimension #Kings looking 4 better paint presence protecting basket”

George Karl on Willie Cauley-Stein, Jun 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @billherenda.
